column4: dialect-gated: cmd/cleat-worker/a_rotating_claim_serves_every_tenant_test.go (cleat#3442) runs one function per dialect, each skipping when its DSN is unset. This job (./cmd/..., CLEAT_TEST_DB / CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES only) runs the PostgreSQL arm and skips these two; Tier 1 sets all three DSNs and runs all three, where a skip is a failure. The skip sites are the three new*RotationRig helpers (scripts/skip-baseline.txt).
